offering_description.value: Underwrites and sells property and casualty insurance policies for small businesses, contractors, commercial property owners and homeowners, mainly in the northeastern United States. Policies are placed through independent insurance agents and brokers, who handle the sales relationship with customers.

primary_products.value: commercial property and liability insurance; commercial auto insurance; homeowners insurance; personal auto insurance; workers compensation insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: small businesses, contractors, commercial property owners; B2C: homeowners and individual vehicle owners

end_markets.value: construction; real estate; hospitality; retail; residential property

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums paid by policyholders for property and casualty coverage

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes on insurance risk from policyholders, collects premiums and pays claims, sold through agents

geography_served.value: US regional: New York and surrounding northeastern states, including New Jersey and Connecticut

specialization.value: related lines: commercial property and casualty, homeowners and personal auto

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and brokers placing policies with the company

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance carrier must hold state licenses, regulated by state insurance departments, mainly New York State Department of Financial Services

notes: Current state footprint and product mix may have changed; description is based on general knowledge.
